title: Add package-manager distribution readiness
summary: Distribution readiness lists package-manager manifests as planned without a dedicated evidence contract. Add a read-only package-manager readiness report and validator that define Homebrew, Nix, Debian/RPM, install/uninstall CI, artifact source, checksum, and publication requirements without publishing packages.
expectedFailureModes: Distribution readiness keeps reporting package-manager distribution as planned without concrete acceptance criteria or local evidence.
Docs imply public package readiness before manifests, checksums, install/uninstall coverage, artifact hosting, signing, and publication approval exist.
Autonomous agents cannot distinguish locally validated package-manager preparation from human-owned publication and signing decisions.
humanEscalation: Human approval remains required for package destinations, artifact hosting, release signing keys, and public publication.
nextAction: Add package-manager distribution readiness evidence, wire it into distribution readiness, and update docs/status while publication and signing remain human-owned.
